hypothesis: In a confirmed 4h uptrend, a 1h EMA20 pullback followed by a close above three preceding highs may resume demand sufficiently often to pay spot costs under a fixed full RR1 exit.
baseline: Identical 1h entry and RR1 execution, with only the 4h trend filter removed; descriptive comparison, never fallback selection.

data_manifest.time_basis: Unknown naive storage clock, aligned integer 1h/4h buckets; not asserted UTC.
data_manifest.price_basis: Treat OHLC as bid for a research fill proxy; limited tick samples support bid predominance, not a verified exchange spot feed.
data_manifest.missing: No imputation; complete 60-M1/240-M1 buckets only; indicators carry over complete observed bars; four signal-window 1h bars must be adjacent. Position holds across absent M1; first observed open applies stop-gap rule; missing intragap extremes unknowable.

direction: spot long only; fractional BTC, fully funded USD cash

higher_timeframe_rules.availability: Most recent complete 4h bar with close_time <= signal close_time and age < 4h
conditions: EMA50 > EMA50 three complete 4h bars earlier
higher_timeframe_rules.ema_initialization: SMA seed of first N complete bars then alpha=2/(N+1), no value before N bars; missing buckets neither synthesized nor counted.

entry_rules.signal: At confirmed 1h bar t: any i in t-3..t-1 satisfies low[i] <= EMA20[i] <= high[i]; close[t] > max(high[t-3..t-1]); close[t] > EMA20[t]. All four bars are complete and calendar-adjacent.
entry_rules.atr: TR=max(high-low,abs(high-prev_complete_close),abs(low-prev_complete_close)); first TR=high-low; first14 TR SMA seed then alpha=1/14
entry_rules.cost_filter: At signal close c, estimated cost = NORMAL spread + 2*c*(NORMAL fee+NORMAL slippage); require stop>0, c-stop>0, estimated_cost/(c-stop)<=0.15. Same normal-cost signal qualification under stress. No next-open gap/risk filter.
entry_rules.order_time: Signal close time equals next 1h open. A market order is modeled at the M1 open at that exact timestamp, with spread/slippage. If that M1 does not exist, expire; do not select a later observed open.
entry_rules.state: One position. No entry while held, or in the storage-clock hour containing the previous exit. Reject invalid bracket when actual entry<=stop.

exit_rules.target: 2*actual_entry-stop, fixed bid trigger; risk/reward defined on intended trigger distances before sell slippage and commissions
exit_rules.bracket: From entry M1 onward: open<=stop -> open; else open>=target -> target; else low<=stop -> stop; else high>=target -> target. If open inside bracket and both touched within M1 -> stop because order unresolved. TP gap gets target, never favorable open.
exit_rules.end: At each half-open period end, liquidate any held quantity at last observed M1 close less sell slippage and fee, report period_end separately. Reset USD10000 and flat for next period. Forced exits need not be +/-1R.

warmup: All available 2017 history initializes indicators. Indicators continue causally across period boundaries; cash and positions reset. A signal available exactly at a period start may use the preceding closed bar.
final_period_prior_exposure: unknown; all three ranges are descriptive diagnostics, not proven untouched holdout or formal adoption stages
search_space: Exactly one fixed rule plus one baseline, no tuning, no replacement after later-period results.

cost_and_fill_model.basis: USD/BTC absolute spread from metadata 60643*10^-3, fixed across history. Fee/slippage are assumed per-side rates, not verified venue charges. Both scenarios use normal-cost signal qualification; stress changes execution/accounting/sizing only, holding duration may differ because targets depend on actual entry.
cost_and_fill_model.exit: raw_bid_exit * (1 - slippage); commissions = fee*quantity*actual_fill on each side; embedded spread/slippage not subtracted again
cost_and_fill_model.financing: No borrowing, swap, funding or cash interest; deposit/withdrawal and tax excluded.

position_sizing_and_currency.signal_sizing: E=(signal_close+spread)*(1+slippage); S=stop*(1-slippage); loss_per_BTC=E-S+fee*(E+S); request=min(cash*.0025/loss_per_BTC,cash/(E*(1+fee))). Cash is known and flat at signal.
position_sizing_and_currency.fill_cap: quantity=min(request,cash/(actual_entry*(1+fee))); automatic simulated affordability cap. Report cap and actual risk incl fees. Adverse gap can exceed .25% planned risk.
position_sizing_and_currency.quantity: Fractional BTC with no venue tick/lot constraint; do not use Forex Tester lot=100000 or margin metadata as spot position size.

acceptance_gates.scope: Provisional research screen only. Evaluate fixed cases on all periods even if training loses; no selection, adoption or Pine authorization follows.
acceptance_gates.both_later_periods_individually: normal closed trades>=100, net_pnl>0, USD profit_factor>=1.1, observed M1-close MTM maximum DD<=20%, stress net_pnl>0
acceptance_gates.limitations_override: True spot feed, timezone, historical costs and unobserved holding gaps unresolved: screen pass is insufficient for adoption.

cross_symbol_rule: BTC only at user request. No multi-asset claim; repeated BTC feeds are not independent assets.

reporting.trade_pnl: USD realized P/L after both fees; net_r normalized by quantity*(actual_entry-stop), exit-year counts and P/L
reporting.equity: Observed M1-close liquidation value: cash_after_buy + qty*bid_close*(1-slippage)*(1-fee). Exit minute replaced by actual realized cash. All observed M1 closes used for DD; equity.csv samples last observed M1 each hour plus entry and exit minutes.
reporting.gaps: gap_exposed if adjacent held M1 timestamps differ >60s; holding_gap_count and missing_minutes=sum(delta/60-1). Separate no-gap-trade summary is post-hoc descriptive subset, never adoption evidence.
reporting.yearly: Trade outcomes grouped by exit calendar year; mtm_change independently includes open exposure across years.
reporting.output: signals.csv, case trades.csv/decisions.csv/equity.csv, results.json, input_manifest.json; empty CSV has empty header

limitations: Forex Tester Advanced Data Feed BTCUSD is not independently confirmed as a specified exchange spot feed.
Naive storage timezone unknown; no named-market session interpretation.
2017-2019 Saturdays absent; 35988 gaps and 640803 missing minutes over source interval; unobserved TP/SL within gaps cannot be recovered.
Metadata spread is a constant assumption, not historical observed spread; fee and slippage are scenario assumptions.
OHLC bid side only partly supported by limited tick samples, full-history provenance unverified.
One-minute intrabar order unresolved; conservative stop-first tie policy and no favorable TP gaps.
One-minute-close DD cannot measure unobserved or intraminute maximum drawdown.
Backtest only: no actual Forex Tester GUI orders, broker connection, or real capital orders.
code_identifier: scripts/research_btc_spot_rr1.py; freeze_manifest.json records exact code/test/protocol SHA256 before results
